# Maigret on the Riviera: Antibes and Cannes in Liberty Bar


The French Riviera is not where you expect to find Inspector Maigret.

He's more naturally associated with rainy Paris streets, smoky cafés, cheap hotels and the complicated lives of people who rarely appear in tourist brochures.

But in Georges Simenon's Liberty Bar, Maigret arrives in Antibes.

There's sunshine everywhere.

The railway station is full of people carrying holiday luggage. White clothes, tennis rackets and palm trees complete the picture of fashionable Mediterranean leisure.

It seems almost too bright for a murder investigation.

Then Maigret begins to look beneath the surface.

The victim, William Brown, is a wealthy Australian with a complicated private life. He has been murdered near Antibes, and his movements lead the inspector west towards Cannes.

There, far from the respectable world of luxurious villas and expensive hotels, Maigret discovers Liberty Bar.

It's a shabby, intimate establishment whose regulars have little in common with the glamorous visitors enjoying the Côte d'Azur.

Yet this forgotten corner of the Riviera may reveal more about Brown than the elegant world he inhabited.

Published in 1932, Liberty Bar is a short, atmospheric novel about divided lives, loneliness and the limits of judging people by their social position.

It's also a fascinating way to explore two real Riviera towns.

This guide follows Maigret's geographical journey from Antibes to Cannes, separates the novel's fictional establishments from real locations and proposes a literary day trip from Menton.

You won't find a reconstructed crime scene or a surviving bar with a guaranteed connection to the story.

Instead, you'll discover two sides of the French Riviera that Simenon understood remarkably well.
fr:
# Maigret sur la Riviera : Antibes et Cannes dans Liberty Bar

On imagine Maigret sous la pluie parisienne plutôt qu'au milieu des valises de vacances. Dans Liberty Bar, le soleil d'Antibes accentue le contraste avec son enquête. William Brown, riche Australien à la vie privée complexe, a été assassiné ; ses habitudes conduisent le commissaire vers Cannes et un bar modeste, loin des façades respectables.

Ce parcours suit les deux villes du roman sans prétendre retrouver chaque scène. Le bar, ses habitués et la solitude derrière le luxe comptent davantage qu'une chasse aux adresses. L'intrigue est présentée sans révéler le coupable.
it:
# Maigret sulla Riviera: Antibes e Cannes in Liberty Bar

Maigret fa pensare alla pioggia di Parigi, non alle valigie da vacanza. In Liberty Bar il sole di Antibes contrasta con l'indagine sulla morte di William Brown, ricco australiano dalla vita privata complicata. Le sue abitudini portano il commissario a Cannes, in un bar modesto lontano dalle apparenze rispettabili.

Il percorso collega le due città del romanzo senza ricostruire ogni scena. Conta il contrasto fra lusso, solitudine e bisogno di compagnia. La premessa è raccontata senza rivelare il colpevole.
uk:
# Мегре на Рив'єрі: Антиб і Канни в Liberty Bar

Мегре легше уявити під паризьким дощем, ніж серед відпускних валіз. У Liberty Bar сонце Антиба контрастує з розслідуванням убивства Вільяма Брауна, заможного австралійця зі складним приватним життям. Його звички ведуть комісара до Канн і скромного бару, далекого від респектабельних фасадів.

Маршрут поєднує два міста роману, не відтворюючи кожну сцену. Тут важливіші самотність і потреба в близькості за декораціями розкоші. Зав'язка подана без розкриття винуватця.

## 1. Discover Liberty Bar by Georges Simenon

Original title: Liberty Bar

Author: Georges Simenon (1903–1989)

First published: 1932, Fayard

Series: Inspector Maigret

Genre: Detective fiction, psychological crime novel

Principal locations: Antibes, Cap d'Antibes and Cannes

Alternative English title: Maigret on the Riviera

English translation: David Watson, Penguin Classics

The novel opens with Maigret arriving in Antibes to investigate the death of William Brown.

Brown's circumstances are unusual.

He had money, complicated domestic relationships and a habit of disappearing for several days at a time.

As the inspector examines the dead man's life, he discovers that Brown inhabited two very different social worlds.

One was associated with wealth and respectable appearances.

The other existed around a modest bar in Cannes.

The investigation gradually becomes less about luxury and more about the people who lived outside it.

### Why read it?

Liberty Bar is a particularly good introduction to Simenon's ability to create atmosphere with very little description.

The novel is short, but its characters feel unusually complete.

Maigret is interested in their habits, disappointments and emotional attachments as much as in the formal evidence of the crime.

Instead of treating the Riviera as an ideal holiday destination, Simenon uses it to explore a contradiction.

A beautiful place can contain lives that are anything but beautiful.

### Where to find the book

[Liberty Bar, Penguin Classics](https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/271991/liberty-bar-by-simenon-georges/9780141396095)

The English Penguin Classics paperback edition contains 160 pages.

Readers looking for older English editions may encounter the alternative title Maigret on the Riviera. It refers to the same novel.

In French, look for Liberty Bar in Simenon's Maigret series.
fr:
## 1. Découvrir Liberty Bar

Georges Simenon (1903–1989), Liberty Bar, première publication française chez Fayard en 1932. Ce court roman policier de la série Maigret se déroule principalement à Antibes, au Cap d'Antibes et à Cannes. Maigret on the Riviera est un autre titre anglais du même livre.

Le [Penguin Classics traduit par David Watson](https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/271991/liberty-bar-by-simenon-georges/9780141396095) compte 160 pages dans l'édition indiquée. Cherchez Liberty Bar pour une édition française. Il s'agit d'un bon point d'entrée dans une œuvre attentive aux habitudes et aux liens affectifs plutôt qu'aux seules énigmes techniques.

## 1. Scoprire Liberty Bar

Georges Simenon (1903–1989), Liberty Bar, prima pubblicazione francese Fayard nel 1932. Breve romanzo poliziesco della serie Maigret, ambientato soprattutto ad Antibes, Cap d'Antibes e Cannes. Maigret on the Riviera è un altro titolo inglese dello stesso libro.

L'edizione [Penguin Classics tradotta da David Watson](https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/271991/liberty-bar-by-simenon-georges/9780141396095) indicata dall'editore ha 160 pagine. In francese cercate Liberty Bar. È un buon ingresso nell'attenzione di Simenon alle abitudini e ai legami emotivi, oltre agli indizi.
uk:
## 1. Знайомство з Liberty Bar

Жорж Сіменон (1903–1989), Liberty Bar, перша французька публікація Fayard 1932 року. Це короткий психологічний детектив серії про Мегре; головні місця — Антиб, Кап-д'Антиб і Канни. Maigret on the Riviera — інша англійська назва того самого роману.

У зазначеному [Penguin Classics у перекладі Девіда Вотсона](https://www.penguin.co.uk/books/271991/liberty-bar-by-simenon-georges/9780141396095) 160 сторінок. Французькою шукайте Liberty Bar. Це добрий початок знайомства з автором, якого цікавлять не лише докази, а й щоденні звички та стосунки.

en:
## 2. Antibes: where the investigation begins

Maigret's arrival in Antibes is one of the novel's most memorable contrasts.

He steps off the train into a world of Mediterranean sunshine and fashionable visitors.

For someone accustomed to working in Paris, the atmosphere seems almost incompatible with the serious purpose of his journey.

But the holiday setting quickly loses its innocence.

### The death of William Brown

Brown is a wealthy Australian who has been living on the Riviera for years.

His personal circumstances are complicated, involving family money, relationships and a lifestyle that doesn't fit neatly into conventional respectability.

He has been killed in Antibes, and Maigret is sent to investigate.

The police investigation begins in an environment where the visible signs of wealth conceal a less orderly private existence.

### The Antibes of the 1930s

By the early twentieth century, Antibes and neighbouring Juan-les-Pins were attracting international visitors, including wealthy Europeans and Americans.

The region was becoming increasingly fashionable as a summer destination.

Private villas, grand hotels, beaches and leisure facilities helped create the glamorous atmosphere associated with the Côte d'Azur.

But Antibes was also a working Mediterranean town.

Its port, historic streets and ordinary businesses existed alongside the expanding resort economy.

That contrast is essential to Liberty Bar.

Simenon's fictional characters inhabit different parts of the same social landscape.
fr:
## 2. Antibes, début de l'enquête

L'arrivée en train confronte Maigret à une ville de loisirs méditerranéens. Derrière la fortune de Brown apparaissent des relations moins simples. Le contraste entre station internationale et ville où l'on travaille aide à lire le roman ; il ne transforme pas toute la vieille ville en scène précisément localisée.
it:
## 2. Antibes, l'inizio dell'indagine

L'arrivo ferroviario introduce una località mediterranea di vacanza. Dietro la ricchezza di Brown si scoprono rapporti meno ordinati. La convivenza tra villeggiatura internazionale e città del lavoro aiuta a leggere il romanzo; non rende ogni vicolo una scena identificata.
uk:
## 2. Антиб: початок розслідування

Приїзд потягом показує Мегре середземноморське місто відпочинку. За грошима Брауна поступово відкриваються менш упорядковані стосунки. Сусідство міжнародного курорту й звичайного робочого міста допомагає читати роман, але не робить кожен провулок точно встановленою сценою.

en:
## 3. Gare d'Antibes: begin where Maigret arrives

Location: Gare d'Antibes.

For a literary visit from Menton, the railway station is an appropriate starting point.

It's also one of the clearest geographical connections with the novel.

The opening description establishes Maigret's arrival by train in Antibes, immediately confronting him with the atmosphere of a Mediterranean holiday resort.

### What should you look for?

Don't expect the present station to be an unchanged reconstruction of the 1932 setting.

Railway buildings, platforms, passenger facilities and surrounding streets have been altered over time.

The point is to experience the same kind of arrival.

You step off a train from the east and enter a town where holiday travel and ordinary life coexist.

### A small literary exercise

Before leaving the station, notice the people around you.

Some may be travelling for work.

Others are on holiday.

Some are arriving for a few hours, while others live locally.

A railway station brings different lives together without revealing much about them.

Simenon uses precisely that contrast when introducing Maigret to the Riviera.

Practical note: The station is a working railway facility. Follow normal passenger routes and don't enter restricted railway areas to reproduce historical perspectives.
fr:
## 3. Gare d'Antibes : commencer par l'arrivée

La gare est un départ pratique et rejoint le motif ferroviaire de l'ouverture. Ce n'est pas un décor de 1932 resté intact. Observez le croisement des voyageurs, habitants et travailleurs, mais restez dans les espaces autorisés : aucun quai ni passage technique ne justifie une reconstitution photographique.
it:
## 3. Gare d'Antibes: partire dall'arrivo

La stazione è un inizio pratico e richiama l'apertura ferroviaria. Non è un set del 1932 rimasto intatto. Osservate viaggiatori, residenti e pendolari, restando negli spazi consentiti. Non entrate in zone tecniche per riprodurre prospettive storiche.
uk:
## 3. Gare d'Antibes: почніть із прибуття

Вокзал — практична початкова точка й перегук із залізничним вступом. Це не незмінні декорації 1932 року. Поспостерігайте за туристами, мешканцями та пасажирами, але залишайтеся в дозволених зонах. Не заходьте в технічні проходи заради історичного ракурсу.

en:
## 4. Vieil Antibes: the town behind the resort

Suggested stop: The historic streets of central Antibes.

From the station, continue towards the old town.

The narrow lanes, small squares, shops and pedestrian passages offer a very different atmosphere from the large hotels and expensive waterfront properties.

### Why include the old town?

Because Liberty Bar is interested in the difference between public appearance and ordinary reality.

Simenon rarely allows a beautiful setting to stand for the whole truth about its inhabitants.

Walking through the old town provides a useful reminder that Antibes existed long before it became an international resort.

Its residents worked, shopped, argued, raised families and dealt with everyday concerns.

The wealthy holiday population formed only one part of that environment.

### Is this a specific scene location?

Not in the sense of a precisely identified fictional doorway or street corner.

The novel names Antibes, but the available bibliographic and publisher sources don't establish a complete modern address-by-address itinerary.

Vieil Antibes is included as a historical and thematic stop.

That makes it worthwhile without inventing a direct connection to a particular paragraph.

### What to do

Explore the streets without rushing.

Notice how quickly the atmosphere changes between busy commercial areas and quiet residential passages.

Take a coffee break or explore the food shops.

It's a good introduction to the Riviera beyond its luxury image.
fr:
## 4. Vieil Antibes : derrière la station balnéaire

Continuez vers les rues historiques, commerces et petites places. Elles rappellent que la ville ne se réduit pas à ses visiteurs fortunés. Prenez le temps d'un café et d'une promenade ; aucune porte ni rue particulière n'est présentée comme une scène indépendamment identifiée.
it:
## 4. Vieil Antibes: dietro la località turistica

Strade storiche, piazzette e negozi ricordano che la città non appartiene solo ai visitatori ricchi. Fermatevi per un caffè e camminate con calma. Nessuna porta o strada è qui presentata come una scena esattamente verificata.
uk:
## 4. Vieil Antibes: місто за курортом

Історичні вулиці, крамниці й невеликі площі нагадують, що місто живе не лише заможними гостями. Зупиніться на каву й не поспішайте. Жодні конкретні двері чи провулок тут не названі незалежно підтвердженим місцем сцени.

en:
## 5. Port Vauban: wealth and work beside the same water

Location: Port Vauban, Antibes.

Antibes' harbour provides a particularly effective visual comparison.

Today, Port Vauban is associated with spectacular yachts and modern marina facilities.

But it also belongs to a much older maritime landscape.

### The contrast

Look towards the large yachts.

Then consider the ordinary work required to maintain a busy port.

Boats must be repaired, supplied, cleaned and operated.

The people who own them and the people who work around them may inhabit very different economic worlds.

This isn't presented as a specific scene from Liberty Bar.

It's a way to explore the novel's recurring interest in the difference between wealth and the lives surrounding it.

### What has changed since Maigret's time?

The modern marina, particularly its facilities for very large yachts, is not a preserved image of Antibes in 1932.

Port development, tourism and changes in the maritime economy have transformed the waterfront.

Use the harbour as a place to compare past and present, not as a literal reconstruction of the novel.

### Practical visit

Walk through publicly accessible waterfront areas.

Enjoy the views over the harbour and historic fortifications.

Respect restricted docks and working facilities.

The port is an excellent place for a short pause before continuing towards Cannes.
fr:
## 5. Port Vauban : richesse et travail

Le port met côte à côte plaisance, yachts et métiers nécessaires à leur fonctionnement. C'est une comparaison thématique avec le regard de Simenon, pas une scène vérifiée. Les installations actuelles diffèrent de celles de 1932. Empruntez uniquement les espaces publics autorisés, sans entrer sur les pontons réservés.
it:
## 5. Port Vauban: ricchezza e lavoro

Yacht, navigazione e attività necessarie al porto convivono nello stesso paesaggio. È un confronto tematico con lo sguardo di Simenon, non una scena accertata. Le strutture moderne non ricostruiscono il 1932. Usate soltanto le zone pubbliche consentite, evitando pontili riservati e aree operative.
uk:
## 5. Port Vauban: багатство й робота

Яхти та праця людей, які їх обслуговують, існують поряд. Це тематичний контраст зі світом Сіменона, не встановлена сцена. Сучасна марина не відтворює 1932 рік. Гуляйте лише дозволеними громадськими зонами, не заходьте на закриті понтони й робочі ділянки.

en:
## 6. Cap d'Antibes: the privileged world surrounding the victim

The investigation also connects with the residential landscape of Cap d'Antibes.

The peninsula is known for large private villas, pine trees, gardens and beautiful stretches of coastline.

During the early twentieth century, it became particularly attractive to wealthy international residents.

### Why does it matter?

The peninsula provides historical context for Brown's privileged lifestyle.

Its geography illustrates the kind of private Riviera world that was increasingly associated with wealth and international leisure.

But Simenon's interest lies in what that world fails to explain.

A luxurious home can reveal how someone lived publicly while concealing much of their private life.

### Can you visit the relevant house?

The published sources used for this guide don't establish a specific independently verified property that visitors can identify as Brown's fictional residence.

Don't enter private estates or search for a supposed crime scene.

If you want to explore Cap d'Antibes, choose public beaches or appropriate coastal paths as a separate extension.

For a one-day literary itinerary that also includes Cannes, it's better to keep the Antibes visit compact.
fr:
## 6. Cap d'Antibes : le monde privilégié de Brown

Villas, jardins et pins donnent un contexte à la richesse du personnage. Les sources consultées n'établissent pas une propriété réelle et visitable qui serait sa maison. N'entrez pas dans les domaines privés. Une plage ou un chemin côtier autorisé peut constituer une extension distincte ; pour voir aussi Cannes, gardez plutôt la matinée compacte.
it:
## 6. Cap d'Antibes: il mondo privilegiato di Brown

Ville, giardini e pini danno un contesto alla ricchezza del personaggio. Le fonti consultate non identificano una sua casa reale e visitabile. Non entrate in proprietà private. Spiagge o sentieri autorizzati possono essere un'estensione separata; per vedere anche Cannes è meglio mantenere compatta la mattinata.
uk:
## 6. Кап-д'Антиб: привілейований світ Брауна

Вілли, сади й сосни дають історичний контекст до багатства персонажа. Перевірені джерела не встановлюють конкретний реальний будинок Брауна, відкритий для відвідувачів. Не заходьте в приватні садиби. Дозволені пляжі чи прибережні стежки можуть бути окремим продовженням; для дня з Каннами краще лишити ранок компактним.

en:
## 7. Cannes: the other side of the investigation

The second major destination is Cannes.

Maigret follows Brown's movements and discovers a social world very different from the prestigious surroundings of Antibes.

Here, the Liberty Bar provides a refuge for people who don't belong to the Riviera's polished public image.

### What kind of place is Liberty Bar?

The official Simenon synopsis describes a modest drinking establishment where people gather to smoke, drink, play games and spend time together.

Its central figures include Jaja, who runs the bar, and Sylvie, a younger woman under her protection.

The relationships among its customers are complicated, sometimes affectionate and often painful.

This is the human world Maigret tries to understand.

### Why Cannes?

Because Cannes provides the perfect contrast.

By the 1930s, it already had an international reputation as a fashionable Mediterranean resort.

Elegant hotels, promenades and private leisure existed alongside ordinary neighbourhoods and less prosperous lives.

Simenon brings both worlds into the same narrative.

### Is the Liberty Bar still there?

No reliable present-day address for the fictional establishment has been established in the sources reviewed for this guide.

It would be misleading to direct visitors to a currently operating bar and present it as Jaja's establishment.

The name belongs to the novel.

The history of Cannes' ordinary streets and cafés provides the useful real-world context.
fr:
## 7. Cannes : l'autre monde de l'enquête

Le synopsis officiel de Simenon présente Liberty Bar comme un refuge modeste où l'on boit, fume et joue. Jaja y règne auprès de Sylvie, qu'elle protège. Brown s'y éloigne de sa vie respectable.

Aucune adresse actuelle vérifiée de cet établissement fictif n'a été établie. Une enseigne contemporaine ou une ressemblance d'ambiance ne suffit pas à en faire le bar du roman.
it:
## 7. Cannes: l'altro mondo dell'indagine

La sinossi ufficiale descrive Liberty Bar come un rifugio modesto dove si beve, fuma e gioca. Jaja vi regna con Sylvie, che protegge. Brown vi cerca qualcosa che la sua vita rispettabile non spiega.

Non è stato stabilito un indirizzo attuale verificato del locale immaginario. Un'insegna moderna o un'atmosfera simile non dimostrano un legame con il romanzo.
uk:
## 7. Канни: інший світ розслідування

Офіційна анотація описує Liberty Bar як скромний прихисток, де п'ють, курять і грають. Тут панує Жажа разом із молодою Сільві, яку вона опікає. Браун шукає тут те, чого не пояснює його респектабельне життя.

Перевіреної сучасної адреси вигаданого закладу не встановлено. Схожа атмосфера чи нинішня вивіска не доводять зв'язку з романом.

en:
## 8. La Croisette: the Riviera that sells the dream

Location: Boulevard de la Croisette, Cannes.

Begin the Cannes section with its best-known promenade.

La Croisette is an international symbol of Riviera glamour.

Luxury hotels, expensive shops and the Mediterranean create a setting designed for visitors to admire.

### Why include it?

Because the novel's central contrast becomes clearer when you begin with the public image of Cannes.

The city is beautiful, wealthy and associated with leisure.

Yet Maigret's investigation leads towards a much less glamorous corner of its social life.

### What to notice

Look at the scale of the hotels and the relationship between the promenade and the beach.

Consider the difference between the city's visible luxury and the lives that remain largely absent from tourist photographs.

### A historical caution

The present-day Croisette is not identical to its 1932 appearance.

Much of the urban landscape has been renovated or redeveloped.

Nor should the modern Cannes Film Festival be projected back onto the novel's setting: the festival began after the Second World War.

The Cannes of Liberty Bar belongs to an earlier tourist era.
fr:
## 8. La Croisette : l'image rêvée de la Riviera

La promenade, les grands hôtels et la plage rendent visible le contraste entre luxe public et vies moins brillantes. L'urbanisme a changé depuis 1932. Le festival de cinéma, dont la première édition effective date de 1946, ne doit pas être projeté sur l'époque du roman. La Croisette reste ici une étape thématique.
it:
## 8. La Croisette: il sogno della Riviera

Passeggiata, grandi alberghi e spiaggia mostrano il contrasto fra lusso visibile e vite meno appariscenti. La città è cambiata dal 1932. Il festival cinematografico, la cui prima edizione effettiva risale al 1946, non appartiene al periodo del romanzo. Anche la Croisette è una tappa tematica.
uk:
## 8. La Croisette: Рив'єра, що продає мрію

Набережна, великі готелі й пляж показують видиму розкіш на тлі менш помітних життів. Міський простір змінився від 1932 року. Кінофестиваль із першою фактичною редакцією 1946 року не слід переносити в час роману. Croisette також є тематичною зупинкою.

en:
## 9. Rue Meynadier: a different Cannes

Location: Rue Meynadier, Cannes.

From the Croisette and central shopping district, continue towards Rue Meynadier.

This historic commercial street offers a useful contrast with the more luxurious waterfront.

Its pedestrian environment is associated with food shops, local businesses and everyday trade.

### Why visit?

Because it's a place where the life of the city becomes more visible.

People buy groceries, talk to shopkeepers and move through practical spaces rather than exclusively through places designed for visitors.

This is closer to the social perspective that makes Maigret such a distinctive fictional detective.

### Is Liberty Bar on Rue Meynadier?

There is no verified evidence supporting that identification.

Rue Meynadier is a thematic stop, not a claimed address from the novel.

The goal is to explore different sides of Cannes, not invent a surviving crime-fiction landmark.
fr:
## 9. Rue Meynadier : un autre visage de Cannes

Cette rue commerçante et piétonne permet de regarder les courses et la vie ordinaire à côté de la façade luxueuse. Elle conduit vers le pied du Suquet. Rien ne prouve que Liberty Bar s'y trouvait : n'y cherchez pas une adresse certifiée de Jaja.
it:
## 9. Rue Meynadier: un'altra Cannes

La strada commerciale pedonale permette di osservare spesa e quotidianità vicino al mondo degli alberghi. Conduce verso il piede del Suquet. Non ci sono prove che Liberty Bar fosse qui: non cercate l'indirizzo certificato di Jaja.
uk:
## 9. Rue Meynadier: інші Канни

Торгова пішохідна вулиця дозволяє побачити покупки й повсякденність поруч із готельним світом. Вона веде до підніжжя Сюке. Немає підтвердження, що Liberty Bar був саме тут: не шукайте сертифікованої адреси Жажі.

en:
## 10. Vieux Port and Le Suquet: Cannes beyond the grand hotels

Locations: Vieux Port de Cannes and Le Suquet.

Finish the day in the historic part of Cannes.

The old port remains one of the city's most recognisable maritime areas.

Above it rises Le Suquet, the historic hillside quarter.

### Two perspectives

From the port, Cannes appears as a place of boats, travel and Mediterranean commerce.

From the older streets above, you see a town whose history extends well beyond luxury hotels and cinema.

These places provide a useful counterpoint to the Croisette.

They also fit the broader spirit of Maigret's investigation.

The inspector is interested in people who inhabit the edges of respectable society.

He doesn't assume that the wealthiest person has the most important story.

### Visiting information

The port can be enjoyed through public waterfront routes.

Le Suquet involves uphill streets and steps.

If you're tired after a day of travelling, it's perfectly reasonable to remain near the harbour rather than climbing to the upper viewpoints.

### Important distinction

Neither Vieux Port nor Le Suquet is presented here as the confirmed exact position of the fictional Liberty Bar.

They are public locations that help visitors understand Cannes beyond its most fashionable image.
fr:
## 10. Vieux Port et Le Suquet

Le port et le quartier historique au-dessus offrent un contrepoint aux hôtels. Restez sur les parcours publics autorisés. Le Suquet comporte montées et marches ; rester près du port est une alternative raisonnable après une longue journée. Ni le port ni le quartier ne sont identifiés comme la position exacte du bar fictif.
it:
## 10. Vieux Port e Le Suquet

Il porto e il quartiere storico soprastante completano il contrasto con i grandi hotel. Seguite percorsi pubblici autorizzati. Le Suquet comprende salite e gradini; restare vicino al porto è un'alternativa sensata dopo una giornata lunga. Nessuno dei due è indicato come posizione esatta del bar.

## 10. Vieux Port і Le Suquet

Порт та історичний квартал над ним дають противагу великим готелям. Дотримуйтеся дозволених громадських шляхів. Сюке має підйоми й сходи; залишитися біля порту після довгої подорожі цілком нормально. Жодна з цих точок не названа точним місцем вигаданого бару.

## 11. A realistic Maigret day trip from Menton

Antibes and Cannes are both accessible by regional train from Menton.

But attempting to explore both thoroughly in one day can become tiring.

The best plan is to choose a few meaningful stops.

### Morning: Antibes

Take a confirmed morning TER from Menton to Antibes.

Allow roughly 65–75 minutes as an indicative planning range, not a promise for your date. The SNCF page available during this review displayed 30 October 2026, not the day of your proposed visit.

Begin at the railway station, as Maigret does in the novel.

Walk towards Vieil Antibes.

Explore the historic centre and continue to Port Vauban if time permits.

Have an early lunch or a coffee break.

### Early afternoon: Cannes

Take a regional train from Antibes to Cannes.

The earlier published SNCF examples show roughly 10–15 minutes between Antibes and Cannes on those trains; this is not a current departure guarantee. Check your actual service.

Begin with La Croisette.

Then explore Rue Meynadier and the area around the old port.

If you enjoy historic streets and have enough energy, continue towards Le Suquet.

### Late afternoon: return to Menton

Allow time to reach Cannes railway station.

Allow roughly 75–90 minutes as an indicative planning range and check the actual Cannes-to-Menton direction. The linked outward SNCF page displayed 28 October 2026 during review; it does not establish a current return train.

Check the actual return train rather than assuming that a frequent daytime service implies convenient late-evening departures.

### Total time

Allow approximately 8–10 hours from leaving Menton to returning, including train travel, walking and meals.

The itinerary is possible without a car and doesn't require paid museum admission.

Its main costs are rail tickets, food and any optional activities.
fr:
## 11. Une journée depuis Menton

Le matin, prenez un TER confirmé vers Antibes : gare, vieille ville, Port Vauban puis pause. En début d'après-midi, rejoignez Cannes en train : Croisette, rue Meynadier, vieux port et Suquet facultatif. Gardez une marge pour revenir à la gare.

Les fourchettes de 65–75 minutes vers Antibes et de 75–90 minutes pour la liaison avec Cannes sont indicatives. Les pages SNCF consultées affichaient respectivement les 30 et 28 octobre 2026, pas votre futur jour de visite. Les exemples anciens montrent environ 10–15 minutes d'Antibes à Cannes. Vérifiez départs, sens Cannes–Menton, dernier retour et travaux ; aucun horaire actuel n'est garanti ici.

Prévoyez environ 8–10 heures au total, repas et marche compris : estimation éditoriale, pas parcours chronométré. Aucun musée payant n'est indispensable ; transport et repas restent à votre charge.

## 11. Una giornata da Mentone

Al mattino prendete un TER confermato per Antibes: stazione, centro storico, Port Vauban e pausa. Nel primo pomeriggio treno per Cannes, poi Croisette, rue Meynadier, porto e Suquet facoltativo. Lasciate margine per raggiungere la stazione al ritorno.

65–75 minuti verso Antibes e 75–90 minuti per il collegamento con Cannes sono soltanto intervalli orientativi. Le pagine SNCF consultate mostravano il 30 e il 28 ottobre 2026, non il vostro futuro giorno di visita. Gli esempi passati indicano circa 10–15 minuti fra Antibes e Cannes. Controllate orari reali, direzione Cannes–Mentone, ultimo ritorno e lavori.

Prevedete circa 8–10 ore con cammino e pasti: proposta editoriale, non percorso cronometrato. Non serve entrare in musei a pagamento; restano trasporti, cibo ed extra scelti.

## 11. Одноденна поїздка з Ментона

Вранці підтверджений TER до Антиба: вокзал, старе місто, Port Vauban і перерва. На початку другої половини дня — потяг до Канн, Croisette, Rue Meynadier, Старий порт і Сюке за бажанням. Залиште запас на повернення до вокзалу.

65–75 хвилин до Антиба й 75–90 хвилин для сполучення з Каннами — лише орієнтири. Відкриті сторінки SNCF показували відповідно 30 і 28 жовтня 2026, не майбутній день вашої поїздки. Старі приклади дають приблизно 10–15 хвилин між Антибом і Каннами. Перевірте конкретні рейси, напрямок Канни–Ментон, останнє повернення та роботи.

Закладіть орієнтовні 8–10 годин із ходьбою та їжею: редакційний план, не виміряний маршрут. Платні музеї не обов'язкові; транспорт, харчування й додаткові заняття оплачуються окремо.

## 12. The slower alternative: two separate literary visits

If you have more time in Menton, this may actually be the better choice.

### Day one: Antibes

Explore the railway arrival, historic centre and harbour.

Add Cap d'Antibes only if you're comfortable with the extra travel and walking.

### Day two: Cannes

Begin at La Croisette.

Explore Rue Meynadier, Vieux Port and Le Suquet.

Take time for a long lunch or an ordinary neighbourhood café.

This two-day approach gives you space to experience the contrast between glamorous and everyday Riviera life without racing between towns.

It's especially useful for longer-stay visitors.
fr:
## 12. L'option plus lente : deux visites

Une sortie consacrée à Antibes permet d'apprécier l'arrivée, le centre et le port, avec Cap d'Antibes seulement en extension. Une autre sortie à Cannes laisse du temps pour Croisette, rue Meynadier, Vieux Port et Suquet, avec un déjeuner tranquille. Pour un séjour long, cette formule évite de courir entre deux villes.
it:
## 12. L'alternativa lenta: due visite

Una giornata per Antibes lascia spazio ad arrivo, centro e porto, con Cap d'Antibes solo come estensione. Un'altra per Cannes consente Croisette, rue Meynadier, Vieux Port e Suquet con pranzo tranquillo. È particolarmente adatto a chi rimane più settimane a Mentone.
uk:
## 12. Повільніший варіант: дві поїздки

Окремий день для Антиба дає час на вокзал, центр і порт, із Кап-д'Антибом лише як продовженням. Інший день для Канн дозволяє не квапити Croisette, Rue Meynadier, Vieux Port і Le Suquet та спокійно пообідати. Особливо зручно для тривалішого перебування в Ментоні.

en:
## 13. What did Simenon understand about the Riviera?

The central strength of Liberty Bar is its refusal to equate beautiful surroundings with happy lives.

Simenon was interested in the ways people divide themselves between different social environments.

Someone might have money, reputation and comfort yet seek companionship in a humble drinking establishment.

Another person might appear insignificant to polite society while playing an essential emotional role in someone else's life.

### Maigret's distinctive method

Maigret is not simply interested in collecting clues.

He spends time observing people.

He listens.

He examines habits and relationships.

He tries to understand the environment in which a person's actions become possible.

This approach makes Liberty Bar particularly atmospheric.

The crime takes place in a wealthy resort.

But the investigation is ultimately concerned with ordinary human needs.

### The less glamorous Riviera

Luxury tourism often encourages visitors to see the coast through hotels, yachts and beautiful villas.

Simenon reminds us that the same region also contains loneliness, economic inequality and complicated personal relationships.

The sunshine doesn't remove those realities.

It simply makes the contrast more striking.
fr:
## 13. Ce que Simenon voit derrière le soleil

Le luxe ne garantit pas une vie heureuse. Brown appartient à plusieurs mondes, et des personnes peu visibles dans la société peuvent tenir une grande place affective. Maigret observe, écoute et cherche à comprendre les relations. Cette lecture du roman ne prétend pas être une nouvelle étude complète du texte.
it:
## 13. Cosa vede Simenon dietro il sole?

Il lusso non garantisce felicità. Brown vive fra ambienti diversi; persone poco considerate dalla società possono avere un ruolo emotivo centrale. Maigret osserva, ascolta e cerca i rapporti dietro le apparenze. È una lettura tematica, non una nuova analisi integrale del testo.
uk:
## 13. Що Сіменон бачить за сонцем?

Розкіш не гарантує щастя. Браун живе між різними середовищами, а непомітні для суспільства люди можуть бути емоційно найважливішими. Мегре спостерігає, слухає й шукає стосунки за зовнішністю. Це тематичне прочитання, не новий повний аналіз тексту.

en:
## 14. Novel, reality and adaptation: three different questions

Liberty Bar has also been adapted for television.

That creates a distinction similar to other guides in our Books & Films collection.

| Layer | What it establishes |
| --- | --- |
| 1932 novel | Antibes and Cannes are part of the fictional investigation |
| Historical Riviera | The real geography and social environment of those towns |
| Television adaptations | Actual locations selected by filmmakers, which require separate verification |

The novel's geographical setting doesn't automatically establish where a television adaptation was filmed.

Nor does a modern café become Liberty Bar simply because it resembles the fictional establishment.

The supplied research identifies television versions starring Jean Richard and Bruno Cremer. The University Côte d'Azur record was unavailable during this check, so their broadcast dates and production locations are not independently verified here.

Both belong to the wider history of Maigret on screen.

A filming-location guide would need to investigate those productions separately.

## 15. What should you read before visiting?

For this route, the obvious choice is Liberty Bar itself.

It's short enough to read during a holiday.

The opening chapters are especially useful before arriving in Antibes.

Pay attention to the contrast between the railway-station atmosphere and the purpose of Maigret's visit.

Then notice how the social environment changes as the investigation moves towards Cannes.

### Other Maigret novels

If you enjoy Simenon's approach, you may want to continue with other novels in the series.

You don't need to read them in strict publication order.

Maigret's methods, personality and interest in human behaviour are established clearly enough for Liberty Bar to work independently.

### Other Riviera fiction

Tender Is the Night by F. Scott Fitzgerald offers a very different view of the wealthy international population along the coast.

Bonjour Tristesse by Françoise Sagan explores the emotional tensions beneath a privileged summer.

The Long Afternoon by Giles Waterfield examines the private world of British expatriates in Menton.

The books differ in genre and period, but they share a recurring question.

What happens behind the beautiful façades of the Riviera?
fr:
## 15. Que lire avant la visite ?

Commencez par Liberty Bar, notamment l'arrivée en gare et le changement d'ambiance vers Cannes. Il peut se lire sans suivre toute la série dans l'ordre. Pour d'autres contrastes entre privilège et vie intime, comparez Tender Is the Night de Fitzgerald, Bonjour Tristesse de Sagan et The Long Afternoon de Giles Waterfield, avec leurs différences de genre et d'époque.
it:
## 15. Cosa leggere prima della visita?

Cominciate da Liberty Bar, soprattutto l'arrivo e il passaggio sociale verso Cannes. Non serve seguire tutta la serie in ordine. Per altri contrasti fra privilegio e vita intima confrontate Tender Is the Night di Fitzgerald, Bonjour Tristesse di Sagan e The Long Afternoon di Giles Waterfield, distinguendo generi ed epoche.
uk:
## 15. Що прочитати до візиту?

Почніть із Liberty Bar, особливо приїзду й зміни соціального світу в Каннах. Усю серію за порядком читати не потрібно. Для інших контрастів привілеїв та особистого життя порівняйте Tender Is the Night Фіцджеральда, Bonjour Tristesse Саґан і The Long Afternoon Джайлза Вотерфілда, не змішуючи жанри та епохи.

en:
## 16. Who will enjoy Liberty Bar?

Readers of classic detective fiction will appreciate the compact investigation and the importance of human observation.

Readers interested in psychological fiction may find Maigret's attention to emotional motives more compelling than elaborate clue-solving.

Travellers interested in Riviera history will enjoy the contrast between international luxury and ordinary town life during the early 1930s.

Fans of Simenon will recognise the author's characteristic economy of description and his sympathy for flawed, vulnerable people.

And visitors who want a precise address-based literary trail should understand the limitation: the cities are real, but not every fictional place can be located or visited today.
fr:
## 16. Pour quels lecteurs ?

Amateurs de polar classique, de psychologie et d'histoire culturelle trouveront une enquête compacte et des personnages ambivalents. Ceux qui souhaitent un circuit d'adresses exactes doivent connaître la limite : les villes existent, mais tous les lieux fictifs ne sont ni localisables ni visitables.
it:
## 16. A quali lettori piacerà?

Agli appassionati di giallo classico, psicologia e storia culturale: l'indagine è compatta e i personaggi non perfetti. Chi cerca indirizzi esatti deve conoscere il limite: le città esistono, ma non tutti i luoghi immaginari sono identificabili o visitabili.
uk:
## 16. Кому сподобається книжка?

Читачам класичного детективу, психологічної прози й культурної історії: розслідування компактне, персонажі неоднозначні. Для шукачів точних адрес важлива межа: міста реальні, але не всі вигадані місця можна знайти чи відвідати.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Liberty Bar set in Menton?

No. The novel's main Riviera settings are Antibes and Cannes. Menton is a convenient starting point for a regional literary day trip.

### When was Liberty Bar published?

It was first published in French by Fayard in 1932.

### Who wrote Liberty Bar?

Belgian novelist Georges Simenon, creator of Inspector Maigret.

### Is Maigret on the Riviera a different novel?

No. It is an alternative English title used for Liberty Bar.

### What is the book about?

Maigret investigates the murder of a wealthy Australian living in Antibes. His inquiries lead to Cannes and a bar frequented by people outside the fashionable resort world.

### Is the Liberty Bar a real establishment?

The sources reviewed don't establish a surviving real bar with a verified connection to the fictional establishment. This guide does not claim one.

### Can you follow Maigret's exact route?

You can visit the real towns and some relevant historic environments, but a precise chapter-by-chapter modern address route has not been independently established.

### How far are Antibes and Cannes from Menton?

Regional trains generally take around 65–75 minutes to Antibes and 75–90 minutes to Cannes, depending on the service.

### Can you visit both in one day?

Yes, with a selective itinerary and a confirmed return train. Separate visits are more relaxed.

### Were there television adaptations?

Yes. The novel has been adapted for television, including versions starring Jean Richard and Bruno Cremer.

### Does this guide reveal the murderer?

No. The article discusses the investigation's premise, settings and themes without revealing the solution.
fr:
## Questions fréquentes

### Le roman se déroule-t-il à Menton ?

Non : surtout à Antibes et Cannes. Menton est le point de départ proposé.

### Date, auteur et autre titre ?

Liberty Bar est publié en français chez Fayard en 1932 par Georges Simenon. Maigret on the Riviera désigne le même roman en anglais.

### Peut-on trouver le vrai bar ou suivre chaque scène ?

Aucune adresse survivante ni reconstitution moderne complète n'est établie dans cette vérification.

### Peut-on voir les deux villes dans la journée ?

Oui avec un programme sélectif et un retour confirmé ; deux sorties sont plus reposantes. Les temps de train restent indicatifs.

### Et les adaptations ou les révélations ?

Leurs lieux nécessitent une recherche distincte. Le guide ne révèle pas la solution du meurtre.

### Дія відбувається в Ментоні?

Ні, переважно в Антибі й Каннах. Ментон запропоновано як базу.

Liberty Bar Жоржа Сіменона вперше вийшов французькою у Fayard 1932 року. Maigret on the Riviera — англійська назва того самого роману.

Так із вибірковим планом і підтвердженим поверненням; дві поїздки спокійніші. Залізничні хвилини залишаються приблизними.

en:
## Final thoughts: the Riviera beyond the postcard

The French Riviera is very good at presenting a beautiful image of itself.

Grand hotels.

Elegant beaches.

Expensive yachts.

White buildings against blue water.

In Liberty Bar, Simenon begins with that familiar image and gradually reveals the lives hidden behind it.

Antibes provides the sunny opening.

Cannes reveals a different social world.

And Maigret moves between them, interested less in appearances than in understanding the people who inhabit each place.

For travellers staying in Menton, following that geographical journey offers a rewarding day trip.

You can discover Antibes' historic streets and harbour, then continue to Cannes and explore beyond the Croisette.

The actual Liberty Bar may remain fictional.

But the contrast Simenon describes is still worth looking for.

Not every interesting Riviera story happens behind the gates of a beautiful villa.

Some unfold in ordinary places, among people who never expected anyone to write about them.
fr:
## Pour finir : au-delà de la carte postale

Antibes fournit l'ouverture lumineuse, Cannes un autre milieu social. Entre port, ruelles et promenade, cherchez le contraste plutôt qu'une façade censée résoudre le roman. Les histoires intéressantes ne se déroulent pas toutes derrière les grilles des grandes villas.
it:
## In conclusione: oltre la cartolina

Antibes offre l'apertura luminosa, Cannes un altro ambiente sociale. Fra porto, vicoli e lungomare cercate il contrasto, non una facciata che pretenda di risolvere il romanzo. Le storie importanti non vivono solo dietro i cancelli delle ville.
uk:
## На завершення: Рив'єра поза листівкою

Антиб дає сонячний початок, Канни — інше соціальне середовище. Між портом, провулками й набережною шукайте контраст, а не фасад, що нібито розв'язує роман. Цікаві історії живуть не лише за воротами розкішних вілл.

Доступ і роботи слід уточнювати; координати не вигадуються.
